user.title: Tarifas ANEEL
user.description: Choose the tariff slice (utility, sub-group, class, sub-class, tariff modality and detail). The slice is validated against the public ANEEL open-data portal before the integration is created.

data_description.distribuidora: Electricity utility (sigla as used by ANEEL).
data_description.subgrupo: Tariff sub-group from your bill (e.g. B1 residential).
data_description.modalidade: Tariff modality (Conventional or White — group B).
data_description.detalhe: Pick SCEE only for the reduced energy tariff with distributed generation; the default is "Not applicable".

error.sem_dados: No tariffs published for this slice at ANEEL. Check the sub-group, class, sub-class and modality (or the SCEE detail).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ANEEL servers. Check the connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This tariff slice is already configured.

init.title: Slice options
init.description: Check the Tax/Rate table on your electricity bill (PIS, COFINS and ICMS).

data.pis_cofins_sem_icms: PIS/COFINS calculated without ICMS in the base

data_description.icms_percentual: ICMS rate from your bill, in % (e.g. 18). Applied as the 'inclusive' gross-up.
data_description.pis_cofins_sem_icms: On (recommended): PIS/COFINS is calculated on the base without ICMS. Off: uses the old formula, with all taxes on the same base.
data_description.cip_cosip_mensal: Monthly CIP/COSIP fixed cost in R$ (informational; not included in R$/kWh).
data_description.update_interval_horas: How often data is fetched from ANEEL (minimum 6 h).
data_description.consumo_entity_id: Total energy drawn from the grid (kWh). Use a total meter (state_class total or total_increasing). Enables the estimated cycle cost.
data_description.injecao_entity_id: Use the total energy exported to the grid, not the day's solar generation.
data_description.dia_leitura: Day of the month when your utility reads the meter (1 to 28). Leave blank to use the calendar month (day 1).
data_description.ponta_inicio: Start of the peak period for your utility (White modality only).
data_description.ponta_fim: End of the peak period (White modality only).

error.icms_invalido: ICMS must be greater than or equal to 0% and below 100%.
error.aliquota_negativa: PIS and COFINS cannot be negative.
error.soma_aliquotas: With the old formula, ICMS + PIS + COFINS must be below 100%.
error.entidades_iguais: The injection sensor must be different from the consumption sensor.

dados_apenas_cache.title: Stale tariff data ({distribuidora})
dados_apenas_cache.description: The Tarifas ANEEL integration has not been able to update the {distribuidora} slice for {dias} days (last real update: {ultima}). The displayed values come from the local cache. Check connectivity or the ANEEL open-data portal; updates will resume automatically.

revisao_impostos.title: Review the taxes ({distribuidora})
revisao_impostos.description: Check ICMS, PIS, COFINS and CIP/COSIP on your electricity bill and update them in the options.
